sentences.en: I would say that Yamada is more of an "herbivore".
sentences.zh: 我觉得山田更像是一位‘食草动物’。

sentences.en: Giraffes can get to food that other herbivores can't reach.
sentences.zh: 长颈鹿可以吃到其他食草动物够不到的食物。

sentences.en: Giraffe's are the largest herbivores in the world.
sentences.zh: 长颈鹿是世界上最大的食草动物。
